title: ToolRequest
description: A tool call requested by a Gemma agent, validated and executed by the deterministic tool layer.

tool_call_id.description: Unique identifier of this tool call.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the requesting agent (e.g. situation_context).

tool_name.description: Allowlisted tool name (e.g. weather, elevation, firms, cadastre, osm, routing, resources).

arguments.description: Tool arguments as validated key/value pairs.

reason.description: Concise agent rationale for requesting this tool.
